verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents a CLI to "operate an existing instance from a terminal" and a public REST API with an OpenAPI spec and generated SDK (OpenAPI confirmed by probe). That gives it its own headless, scriptable access for automation, but nothing shows a non-interactive or CI mode for running the product itself. missing for 10: explicit headless/CI run mode documentation, CI pipeline examples or non-interactive auth (e.g. API tokens for CI), detail on CLI command coverage, independent hands-on corroboration.
